jira.integrationsDesc: Connect your Jira Cloud account to import User Stories from Active Sprints into Scrum Poker rooms and sync story point consensus back automatically.
jira.description: Sync User Stories from Jira Active Sprint to Scrum Poker room and write back Story Points automatically.
jira.helperNote: Pointify never stores your Jira password. Permissions are strictly scoped to reading Active Sprint User Stories and updating story points agreed during poker sessions.
jira.statusActive: Connected and ready to sync with Scrum Poker rooms.
jira.disconnectConfirmDesc: You will not be able to import User Stories or sync estimates back to Jira until you reconnect.
jira.connectFailed: Failed to connect to Jira Cloud
jira.boardsError401Hint: Error 401 Unauthorized: Jira Software permissions (read:board-scope:jira-software) are missing or the session has expired. Please reconnect your Jira account.
jira.boardsErrorDefault: An error occurred while connecting to the Jira API.
jira.sprintError401Desc: The app lacks permission to read Sprints (read:sprint:jira-software) or the connection has expired. Please reconnect Jira.
jira.sprintAutoLoadedHint: User stories in this sprint will automatically be populated as pinned sticky notes on the canvas.
